03 / About

Precise planning.
Design with character.

I'm Ahuva Reich, an architect and interior designer with extensive experience planning and designing private homes and apartments.

I guide every project from the first idea to the final key, especially for clients who live abroad: you don't need to be here for your home to be built right. I manage the process with the contractors and with you, so you can feel at ease every step of the way.

For every client I develop a personal design language — one that reflects you, not a passing trend. Good design shouldn't just look beautiful — it should work for you, every single day.

Service Area Jerusalem & Central Israel
Specialty Private homes & apartments
